name: @fsm/erpnext-docs-mcp
description: MCP server over the pinned Frappe/ERPNext source indexes and the docs.frappe.io mirror.
_comment: The build bundles the SDK into dist/index.js. dist is committed (see ../.gitignore) so the server starts in a fresh clone, and a bundle is what makes that true - an unbundled dist would still need node_modules that a fresh checkout does not have.
